verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for a structured llms.txt at docs.chronicle-labs.com, and the marketing site also serves /llms.txt. Docs pages are published as raw .md URLs (introduction.md, platform/*.md, api-reference/*.md), which an agent can ingest directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or documented guidance for agent consumption, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404).
